name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Selects one or more options, alone or in a labelled group, with indeterminate and invalid states.

examples.name: checkbox-demo
examples.title: Checkbox
examples.description: With a description linked to the input.

examples.name: checkbox-indeterminate
examples.title: Indeterminate
examples.description: A "select all" parent for a set of options.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Shows a dash, e.g. for a partially selected "select all".

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Standalone only (e.g. accepting terms with isRequired). In a group, the group shows errors.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the group label.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown with an icon when the group is invalid.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stack options, or lay them out in a wrapping row.

props.name: isRequired / isInvalid / isDisabled
props.description: Validation and disabled state for the whole group.

notes: Uses a native checkbox input, so forms and assistive tech work without extra ARIA.
Each row is at least 24px tall and the whole label is clickable (WCAG 2.5.8).
Descriptions are linked with aria-describedby and stay out of the accessible name.
Invalid state shows a danger border plus an error message with an icon.

do: Use for independent on/off choices or picking several items from a list.
Write labels as positive statements: "Email me about updates".
Use a group label that names the question.
dont: Don't use a checkbox for settings that apply immediately; use a Switch.
Don't use checkboxes for mutually exclusive options; use RadioGroup.
